item.title: Vance, Rubio meeting with Greenland and Denmark's foreign ministers - WDEF
item.description: Vice President JD Vance, Secretary of State Marco Rubio and other White House officials are meeting Wednesday with Danish and Greenlandic foreign ministers amid the Trump administration's ongoing threats to take over Greenland.

item.title: Boyd Buchanan to Hold Prayer Vigil for Faculty Member - WDEF
item.description: Boyd Buchanan School has shared that a vigil will be held for a faculty member who passed away unexpectedly.

item.title: Search Warrant Leads to Drug Bust and Recovery of Stolen Items - WDEF
item.description: A McMinn County search warrant execution led to the recovery of stolen items along with a drug bust on January 12.

item.title: Torikaya Comes to Chattanooga - WDEF
item.description: Torikaya, a chef-driven Japanese restaurant, will open in downtown Chattanooga in February of 2026.

item.title: Food City Contributes to The Happy Shoes Project - WDEF
item.description: Food City has shared that they have contributed to The Happy Shoes Project in support of cancer patients.

item.title: Skeletal remains found on Washington beach identified as former Oregon mayor who vanished in 2006 - WDEF
item.description: The remains of a former Oregon mayor have been identified two decades after his disappearance, according to the forensics laboratory that helped confirm the ID.

item.title: River City Company Partners with Retail Strategies to Bring New Business to Downtown Chattanooga - WDEF
item.description: River City Company has announced it will be partnering with Retail Strategies to bring new opportunities to Downtown Chattanooga.

item.title: Top doctors arrested after 9 newborns die at hospital in Russia: "A crime against the country" - WDEF
item.description: Courtesy: CBS Russian police have arrested the chief physician and the acting head of intensive care at a Siberian hospital where nine babies died this month, prosecutors said Wednesday. The case, which has shone a spotlight on chronic staff shortages and funding gaps in the country’s medical system, has provoked anger and bewilderment from Russian politicians and online commentators. item.title: Verizon Outage Felt Across the Nation - WDEF
item.description: A Verizon outage has affected individuals and businesses across the nation.

item.title: HPAI Detected in Walker County Poultry Flock - WDEF
item.description: Highly Pathogenic Avian Influenza (HPAI) has been detected in a commercial poultry flock in Walker County, according to Georgia Agriculture Commissioner Tyler Harper.
